payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is at least one frog visibly placed within the toilet bowl opening?
node.criteria: complete: at least one frog is visibly positioned within the bowl opening, below the rim. partial: a frog is present on or near the toilet but none is clearly within the bowl opening, or its placement is only partly established. absent: no frog has been added to the scene. unknown: the image does not provide enough evidence to determine whether a frog is within the bowl opening. Judge the frog's position relative to the bowl and rim; additional frogs elsewhere do not negate a frog correctly placed in the bowl.
node.binding: Frog(s) and the toilet bowl opening, grounded in the edited image.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"A frog is visibly positioned inside the toilet bowl opening, below the rim. Other frogs appear on the raised lid and beside the toilet.","confidence":0.99}
